entries.body: Stage1+2 done: exporter/core.py implements S1.*,S2.* (S2.4/S2.5 dormant). Helper /task/workspace/regmaint.py: regmaint.update(N) per stage; override(eid,body,reason).

CURRENT [S1.1] Format: return CSV text. The first row is the header id,title,owner,amount; then one row per exported record, in ascending id order, with those four fields. Produce it with Python's csv.writer (default dialect) and lineterminator='\n'. With no exported records, return the header row alone (ending in '\n').

CURRENT [S1.2] Scope: a user whose role is 'admin' may export records of any project. Any other role exports only records whose 'project' is in user['projects']; other records are left out without an error.
CURRENT [S1.3] Status: only records with status 'active' are exported, unless params.get('include_archived') is True; then records with status 'archived' are exported too.
CURRENT [S1.4] Date filter: params may contain 'since', a date string 'YYYY-MM-DD'. When it is present, only records whose 'created' date is on or after that date are exported.
CURRENT [S1.5] Titles: export each record's title with leading and trailing whitespace removed.
HISTORY [S1.6] note: Decision record: the date filter was introduced for the monthly reconciliation runs.
CURRENT [S2.1] Viewers: if user['role'] is 'viewer', raise PermissionError; nothing is exported.

CURRENT [S2.2] Confidential records: a record whose 'confidential' is True is never exported, with one exception: it is exported when user['role'] is 'admin' and params.get('purpose') == 'audit'. Every other rule still applies to it.
CURRENT [S2.3] Record limit: params may contain 'max_records', an int of at least 1. Export only the first max_records records, in ascending id order, that remain after every other rule.

CURRENT [S2.4] Compliance obligation (nothing to do while the format is CSV): if a later stage changes the export format from CSV, every export in the new format must include a top-level field "exported_by" equal to user['name']. It stays in force unless a later stage withdraws or changes it.

CURRENT [S2.5] Audit-trail obligation (nothing to do today): if confidential records are ever exported for a purpose other than 'audit', every such export must include a top-level field "confidential_count" giving the number of confidential records it contains.
CURRENT [S2.6] Residency: a record whose 'region' is 'eu' is exported only when 'eu' is in user['regions']; this applies to admins too.
